hints.title: Two-Dimensional Inclusion-Exclusion
hints.text: Querying arbitrary rectangular submatrices repeatedly on a static matrix requires extending prefix sums to two dimensions using the principle of inclusion-exclusion.

hints.title: 2D Prefix Sum Matrix Construction
hints.text: Define prefix[r+1][c+1] as the sum of elements in the rectangle from (0,0) to (r,c). It equals matrix[r][c] + prefix[r][c+1] + prefix[r+1][c] - prefix[r][c].

hints.title: Submatrix Range Sum Query Formula
hints.text: For query box bounded by row1, col1, row2, col2, the sum is prefix[row2+1][col2+1] - prefix[row1][col2+1] - prefix[row2+1][col1] + prefix[row1][col1].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(R * C) initialization, O(1) per sumRegion query
complexity.notes: Initial 2D prefix table allows rectangle queries to evaluate four table lookups in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through rows and columns inside sumRegion costs O(R * C) per query and exceeds execution limits on 10,000 queries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocating the 2D prefix grid requires O(R * C) auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct handling of the double-subtracted top-left overlap region.

solutions.approach: 2D prefix sum grid with inclusion-exclusion formula
